name: Sapling Nursery

abilities.text: Whenever a land you control enters, create a 3/4 green Treefolk creature token with reach.
{1}{G}, Exile ~: Treefolk and Forests you control gain indestructible until end of turn.

notes: APPROXIMATION: AbilityCost has no 'exile this permanent' part, so the exile is written as the first EFFECT of the ability instead of as part of its cost - the card really is exiled, but on resolution rather than on activation, so the ability could be activated twice in response to itself (see needs).

issues: {1}{G}, Exile this enchantment: ... — expected exiling the enchantment is a COST, paid on activation; the ability cannot be activated twice, and the card is exiled even if the ability is countered — scripted cost is only {1}{G}; the exile is the first EFFECT of the ability (script notes admit this). The ability can be activated repeatedly in response to itself, and a countered activation leaves the enchantment on the battlefield — CR CR 601.2h / 602.2b — costs are paid as part of activating, and cannot be undone by countering the ability

Affinity for Forests / Landfall / token — expected cost reduced by Forests you control; 3/4 green Treefolk with reach on each land you control entering — scripted correct — costModifiers reduce by count of Forest-subtyped permanents you control, landfall trigger, and the token body/color/subtype/reach all match. The 'Treefolk and Forests' grant is also correct: filter subtypes are OR-matched (characteristics.ts:224 uses .some)

{1}{G}, Exile this enchantment: Treefolk and Forests you control gain indestructible until end of turn. — expected exiling the enchantment is part of the ACTIVATION COST — paid on announcement, cannot be activated a second time, and cannot be responded to by removing the enchantment — scripted cost is {1}{G} only; the exile is the first EFFECT on resolution (self-disclosed approximation). The ability can be activated repeatedly in response to itself, and the enchantment can be destroyed in response to fizzle nothing — CR 602.2b, 601.2h

Treefolk and Forests you control — expected OR — every Treefolk plus every Forest you control — scripted for-each over {subtypes:['Treefolk','Forest'], who:'you'}. Verified OR: characteristics.ts:224 uses f.subtypes.some(...). The render's 'for each Treefolk Forest you control' is cosmetic phrasing only, not an AND bug

Affinity for Forests / Landfall — expected cost reduced {1} per Forest you control; token on each land you control entering — scripted costModifiers reduce by {count:'permanents-you-control', filter:{subtypes:['Forest']}} (evaluated in cost.ts:37) and event {on:'landfall'} which already requires ctx.player===perm.controller (game.ts:2179). Both correct — CR 702.40
